# Codex Run Audit

> An offline TypeScript CLI that turns an explicit Codex execution JSONL export into local HTML and JSON reports for token accounting, command failures, repeated activity, and source-order timelines.

Version 0.1.0 is an unreleased private preview. The GitHub repository requires
access; no npm package or public release exists. Node.js 24+ is required. MIT
license. Zero runtime dependencies. Independent of OpenAI.

The supported input is codex exec --json output, not raw session-history rollout
files. Completed execution is separate from verified task success. Missing
usage, billing cost, subscription allowance, model identity and unsupported
measurements stay unknown. Comparisons are descriptive, not causal benchmarks.
Analysis is local and credential-free; no model calls or transcript uploads.

Best fit: inspecting one explicit export, reviewing recorded activity, and sharing
a reviewed report. Outside current scope: account-wide billing, session-history
scanning, autonomous repair, orchestration, and proven productivity improvements.
